subject.title: fix(reef): bound JSONL store file reads to prevent OOM on oversized audit/replay stores

question: Should Reef reject an existing oversized replay ledger until an operator safely rotates or compacts it, accepting temporary receipt-processing failure to preserve the receipt-reuse invariant?
rationale: The code correctly avoids the previously unsafe bounded-prefix auto-compaction, but choosing between temporary delivery interruption and a new lossless recovery mechanism is a product and security-boundary contract rather than a mechanical patch decision.

options.title: Approve fail-closed recovery
options.body: Accept the current oversized-ledger error and document the supported safe operator rotation or compaction procedure.

options.title: Require lossless recovery first
options.body: Keep the PR open until Reef provides a bounded, lossless migration that retains all receipt bindings before rewriting the ledger.

options.title: Pause this mitigation
options.body: Do not merge a new operator-blocking contract until Reef ownership and recovery expectations are defined.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the current oversized-ledger error and document the supported safe operator rotation or compaction procedure.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current recovery-policy iteration and can incorporate the selected direction, though longer-term area ownership was not established.
